**Implementation note:** Catalog MR3 variant: Kalman hedge ratio, long-only spread signal.

## Description

Update a pair's hedge ratio over time with a Kalman filter and trade deviations around a dynamic spread.

## Where it may fit

Relationships that drift gradually rather than remain fixed.

## Vehicles

Equity pairs, ETF pairs, futures spreads.

## Required data

Synchronized price/return series, filter state/noise parameters, bid/ask, borrow and costs.

## Caveats

Flexible filters may adapt to noise rather than a genuine relationship; validate parameter stability.
